exposure: Maternal data from gestation to delivery
cohort: The study included 154,755 inpatient live births of early term and preterm neonates born prior to 39 weeks gestational age in Queensland, Australia, between January 2009 and December 2015.
finding: A gradient boosted trees model achieved very high discrimination for neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (AUC = 0.923) and good discrimination for hypoglycaemia (AUC = 0.832) prior to discharge, outperforming logistic regression models.
